# `jsf_lotka_volterra()`

Simulate a Lotka-Volterra predator-prey model using JSF

## Usage

```r
jsf_lotka_volterra(
  prey0 = 50,
  predator0 = 10,
  prey_birth = 2,
  predation = 0.05,
  predator_death = 1.5,
  t_max = 10,
  dt = 0.01,
  switching_threshold = 30
)
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `prey0` | Initial prey population. |
| `predator0` | Initial predator population. |
| `prey_birth` | Prey birth rate. |
| `predation` | Predation rate. |
| `predator_death` | Predator death rate. |
| `t_max` | Final simulation time. |
| `dt` | Time step for the continuous/ODE part of JSF. |
| `switching_threshold` | Switching threshold for both species. |

## Value

A data frame with columns `time`, `prey`, and `predator`.

## Description

This function runs a simple Lotka-Volterra predator-prey model using the
Python `jsf` package through `reticulate`.
